name: choregos
description: Connect Claude Code to Choregos: follow work items, open requests, see what waits for your decision.

mcp_url.title: Choregos MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The MCP door of your platform, such as https://choregos.example.com/mcp — shown in Integrations, in the console.

token.title: Choregos MCP token
token.description: A token with scope mcp:read or mcp:write, created in Integrations. A full-access token is refused by the door.
